root_cause.text: The bounds check in `stream_encoder_create()` used `eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF` (where `ENGINE_ID_DIGF` is 5), which allowed `eng_id` values of 5 or negative numbers, causing out-of-bounds access when indexing into the 5-element `stream_enc_regs[]` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (eng_id <= ENGINE_ID_DIGF)` to `if (eng_id < 0 || eng_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(stream_enc_regs))`, and the CVE description notes that `stream_enc_regs[]` has 5 entries and `ENGINE_ID_DIGF` is 5, so `eng_id=5` indexes one element beyond the end. Smatch error explicitly states "may index stream_enc_regs[eng_id] out of bounds (size 5)."
